name: Grammar Check SLM
summary: Grammar and spelling corrections powered by small language models running on your device. Your text stays local.
technical: Qwen models run locally through Transformers.js with WebGPU or WASM, with Gemini Nano as an optional engine. Sentence caching avoids repeated checks, while word-level diffs place suggestions in the right text range.

name: Dev Toolbox
summary: Everyday developer utilities in one browser-based workspace: format JSON, inspect JWTs, compare text, and work with PDFs and images.
technical: Angular progressive web app with lazy-loaded tools and local file processing. A shared WebLLM worker handles on-device AI without blocking the interface.

name: SWAN Package Manager
summary: A Jupyter Notebook extension for managing Python dependencies per SWAN project, designed to make shared scientific notebooks easier to reproduce.
technical: Python server APIs and a JavaScript notebook interface, with a separate conda environment for each SWAN project. The prototype keeps project dependencies separate.
